_doc.zh: 由 bun tools/voice/pack.ts 生成。VIVAE 语料中 185 条「身体疼痛」发声的录音（表演出来的，不是真实疼痛时的录音）及其分析。仅限非商业使用（CC BY-NC 4.0）。本目录是独立的集合，不属于本仓库的 CC BY-SA 解剖数据集，也不属于 MIT 代码；用于商业用途的构建或部署必须删除本目录，应用会自动改用参数合成器。
_doc.en: Generated by bun tools/voice/pack.ts. The 185 recordings of "physical pain" vocalisations from the VIVAE corpus (acted, not recorded during real pain) with their analysis. Non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC 4.0). This directory is a separate collection: it is not part of this repository's CC BY-SA anatomy dataset nor of its MIT code; a build or deployment for commercial use must delete this directory, and the app then falls back to the parametric synthesizer.

source.title: The Variably Intense Vocalizations of Affect and Emotion Corpus (VIVAE)
source.citation: Holz, N., Larrouy-Maestri, P., & Poeppel, D. (2022). The Variably Intense Vocalizations of Affect and Emotion (VIVAE) corpus prompts new perspective on nonspeech perception. Emotion, 22(1), 213–225. http://dx.doi.org/10.1037/emo0001048

changes.zh: 相对原语料的改动：只选取了 full set 中情绪为 pain 的 185 个文件；从 44.1 kHz 重采样到 24 kHz（16 位单声道 WAV，文件名不变）；加入了本清单里的逐条分析（时长、平均基频、电平、谐噪比、发声类型、每秒 100 帧的轨迹）。
changes.en: Changes from the original corpus: only the 185 files of the full set whose emotion is pain were selected; they were resampled from 44.1 kHz to 24 kHz (16-bit mono WAV, file names unchanged); the per-clip analysis in this manifest was added (duration, mean F0, level, HNR, vocalisation type, tracks at 100 frames per second).

mouthMethod.zh: 张口度是启发式估计：500–2000 Hz 与 80–500 Hz 的能量比（−6 dB → 0，+18 dB → 1），乘以随帧电平开合的门，五帧滑动平均。没有用口型数据验证过。
mouthMethod.en: Mouth opening is a heuristic estimate: the energy ratio between 500–2000 Hz and 80–500 Hz (−6 dB → 0, +18 dB → 1) times a gate that follows the frame level, with a five-frame moving average. Not validated against articulation data.

typeMethod.zh: 发声类型由规则给出，不是人工标注：有声帧不到 30% → inhalation（其实只是「以气声为主」，分不出吸气还是呼气）；基频中位数 ≥ 700 Hz → scream；短于 0.5 秒且基频中位数低于 450 Hz → grunt；平均张口度估计低于 0.35 → moan；其余 → cry。
typeMethod.en: The vocalisation type comes from rules, not from human labels: under 30 % voiced frames → inhalation (really just "breath-dominated"; inhaling and exhaling cannot be told apart); median F0 ≥ 700 Hz → scream; shorter than 0.5 s with median F0 below 450 Hz → grunt; mean mouth-opening estimate below 0.35 → moan; otherwise → cry.
